uncertain: Board identity: the image is a shared system/block diagram (V1.0) that does not name the Station-485 variant; the RS485/PWR485 section and 18650 battery are marked OPTIONAL.

The PWR485 connector is drawn as a small colored-cell illustration on the device outline; it is assumed to show physical pin order (B, A, V, G). A separate block-diagram legend lists the same pins as G V A B.
Grove ports P.A1, P.A2, P.B1, P.B2, P.C1, P.C2 are shown only with GPIO pairs (33/32, 33/32, 35/25, 36/26, 13/14, 16/17) and no individual pin positions, so they were not transcribed.
Pin order: the USB OUTPUT port is at the top center and roughly equidistant from both ends of the PWR485 row; left-to-right order was used.
notes: Most of the image is a block diagram (AXP192, INA3221, CH9102, SP3485, LCD). USB ports skipped per rule 1.
